howto: Press Play. Pick MISSIONS (60 seconds, three star scores) or CLASSIC (the old best-score run).
Drag to steer the hole. It swallows anything smaller than itself and grows with every bite.
Bites in a row build a chain that adds bonus points; time stars add five seconds; golden things are worth extra.
A mission is cleared with one star at the first score target; higher targets earn two and three stars.
Coins buy new hole rims; new rims also unlock from stars, levels and day streaks.
tips: Chain bites without a two second gap: the bonus climbs to +22 a bite.
Grab time stars when the clock is low; they also make the hole a little bigger.
The four worlds (Town Park, Bakery Lane, Old Plaza, Night Market) change what is on the ground.
A daily goal pays coins once a day; playing on consecutive days lights the week stamps.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD steer the hole. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Drag anywhere to move the hole

difficulty: Star targets rise with the mission number; the world changes every five missions and the mix of things to swallow changes with it. Classic is unchanged.

cheats.effect: Mega hole: the hole starts huge
Extra time: 30 more seconds on the clock
Gold rush: everything is golden and worth +2

features.one-tap-start: Play, then the first drag starts the clock
features.instant-restart: Play Again on the Time's Up card starts a new round at once
features.best-score-badge: Best pill in the top bar during play, and on the Time's Up card
features.tutorial-card: Get-ready card with a dragging finger; the clock waits until you move
features.results: Result card with stars, score, coins, best and Next Mission
features.levels: MISSIONS mode with a mission picker and stars per mission
features.stars: Three stars per mission (score targets), star marks on the progress bar
features.worlds: Four worlds with their own ground and things to swallow
features.unlocks: Nine hole rims: free, stars, coins, level or day-streak unlocks
features.daily-goal: One seeded daily goal with a coin reward, week stamps and a day streak

settings.quality: Title screen > GRAPHICS: HIGH / LOW (Low renders at 1x resolution with no shadows, no houses, benches or lamps round the park and fewer particles)
